question.en: Do I Qualify for Medicare Extra Help (LIS) in Missouri in 2026?
question.es: ¿Califico para la Ayuda Adicional de Medicare (LIS) en Missouri en 2026?

shortAnswer.en: Yes, if income is under $23,940 (single) or $32,460 (couple) in 2026.
shortAnswer.es: Sí, si sus ingresos son menores a $23,940 (soltero) o $32,460 (pareja) en 2026.

fullAnswer.en: Yes. Missouri Medicare beneficiaries qualify for Extra Help in 2026 with income below 150% of the Federal Poverty Level, $23,940 for a single person or $32,460 for a married couple, and resources under $16,590 single or $33,100 married. Missourians already enrolled in MO HealthNet or a MO HealthNet Medicare Savings Program are deemed eligible automatically. Everyone else applies through Social Security or the Family Support Division.
fullAnswer.es: Sí. Los beneficiarios de Medicare en Missouri califican para la Ayuda Adicional en 2026 con ingresos menores al 150% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, $23,940 para una persona soltera o $32,460 para una pareja casada, y recursos menores a $16,590 soltero o $33,100 casado. Los residentes de Missouri ya inscritos en MO HealthNet o en un Programa de Ahorros de Medicare de MO HealthNet son elegibles automáticamente.

h1.en: Medicare Extra Help (LIS) and MO HealthNet in Missouri (2026)
h1.es: Ayuda Adicional de Medicare (LIS) y MO HealthNet en Missouri (2026)

introParagraphs.en: Missouri counted more than 1.1 million Medicare beneficiaries in 2026, and a large share of them qualify for Extra Help, the federal Low-Income Subsidy (LIS) that pays most of the Part D premium, waives the deductible, and caps prescription drug copays. Social Security sets the income and resource limits nationally, but Missouri residents have a distinct path into the program through MO HealthNet, the state's Medicaid agency, which runs Missouri's Medicare Savings Programs and can deem beneficiaries automatically eligible.
introParagraphs.es: Missouri tenia mas de 1.1 millones de beneficiarios de Medicare en 2026, y una gran parte califica para la Ayuda Adicional, el Subsidio Federal de Bajos Ingresos (LIS) que paga la mayor parte de la prima de la Parte D, elimina el deducible y limita los copagos de medicamentos. Los limites de ingresos y recursos los fija el Seguro Social a nivel nacional, pero los residentes de Missouri tienen una via distinta hacia el programa a traves de MO HealthNet, la agencia estatal de Medicaid, que puede calificar automaticamente a los beneficiarios.

introParagraphs.en: Missouri residents will find the exact 2026 Extra Help income limits by household size below, along with how MO HealthNet's Qualified Medicare Beneficiary (QMB), Specified Low-Income Medicare Beneficiary (SLMB), and Qualified Individual (QI) programs grant automatic eligibility, and the step-by-step application process through the Family Support Division for those who need to apply directly. For income limits on Missouri's Medicaid program itself, see [Medicaid income limits](/en/medicaid-income-limits). To check multiple programs at once, use the [Benefits Screener](/en/screener).
introParagraphs.es: Esta pagina detalla los limites exactos de ingresos de la Ayuda Adicional de 2026 por tamano de hogar, como MO HealthNet otorga elegibilidad automatica a traves de sus Programas de Ahorros de Medicare, y el proceso de solicitud paso a paso para los residentes de Missouri que necesitan solicitar directamente.

heading.es: Respuesta Directa para Residentes de Missouri

paragraphs.en: Yes. Missouri Medicare beneficiaries qualify for Extra Help in 2026 if household income is below 150% of the Federal Poverty Level ($23,940 single, $32,460 married) and countable resources stay under $16,590 single or $33,100 married. Missourians on MO HealthNet or a MO HealthNet Medicare Savings Program are deemed eligible automatically, with no separate application required.
paragraphs.es: Sí. Los beneficiarios de Medicare en Missouri califican para la Ayuda Adicional en 2026 si el ingreso del hogar es menor al 150% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($23,940 soltero, $32,460 casado) y los recursos contables son menores a $16,590 soltero o $33,100 casado.

heading.en: Missouri Extra Help Income Limits by Household Size (2026)
heading.es: Limites de Ingresos de la Ayuda Adicional en Missouri por Tamano del Hogar (2026)

paragraphs.en: Missouri uses the same nationwide Extra Help income thresholds that apply in every state except Alaska and Hawaii, the two states with higher federal poverty guidelines. The table below shows the 2026 limits at 150% of the Federal Poverty Level for each household size, along with the monthly equivalent Missouri applicants can compare against a pay stub, pension statement, or Social Security award letter.
paragraphs.es: Missouri usa los mismos umbrales de ingresos de la Ayuda Adicional a nivel nacional que aplican en todos los estados excepto Alaska y Hawaii. La tabla siguiente muestra los limites de 2026 al 150% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza para cada tamano de hogar.

heading.en: Missouri Resource (Asset) Limits for Extra Help in 2026
heading.es: Limites de Recursos (Activos) para la Ayuda Adicional en Missouri en 2026

paragraphs.en: Missouri applicants must also pass a resource test separate from the income test: countable assets below $16,590 for a single person or $33,100 for a married couple in 2026. Countable resources include checking and savings accounts, certificates of deposit, stocks, bonds, mutual funds, and retirement account balances not yet in payout status. A Missouri applicant's home, one vehicle, and personal belongings do not count toward the limit.
paragraphs.es: Los solicitantes en Missouri tambien deben pasar una prueba de recursos: activos contables por debajo de $16,590 para una persona soltera o $33,100 para una pareja casada en 2026. Los recursos contables incluyen cuentas corrientes y de ahorro, CD, acciones, bonos, fondos mutuos y saldos de cuentas de jubilacion que no esten en fase de pago.

paragraphs.en: Missouri residents who notify Social Security of a burial set-aside can raise the resource limit to $18,090 single or $36,100 married in 2026, excluding up to $1,500 per person set aside for burial expenses from the countable total.
paragraphs.es: Los residentes de Missouri que notifiquen al Seguro Social sobre una reserva para gastos funerarios pueden elevar el limite de recursos a $18,090 soltero o $36,100 casado en 2026, excluyendo hasta $1,500 por persona reservados para gastos de entierro.

heading.en: MO HealthNet Medicare Savings Programs and Automatic Eligibility in Missouri
heading.es: Programas de Ahorros de Medicare de MO HealthNet y Elegibilidad Automatica en Missouri

paragraphs.en: MO HealthNet, Missouri's Medicaid agency, runs three Medicare Savings Programs that double as an automatic gateway into Extra Help. Qualified Medicare Beneficiary (QMB) covers Missourians with income at or below 100% of the Federal Poverty Level, $1,330 a month for an individual in 2026, and pays Part A and Part B premiums plus cost-sharing. Specified Low-Income Medicare Beneficiary (SLMB) covers income between 100% and 120% FPL, up to $1,596 a month, and pays only the Part B premium. Qualified Individual (QI), listed as SLMB-2 on some Missouri forms, covers income between 120% and 135% FPL, up to $1,796 a month, pays only the Part B premium, and runs on limited annual funding awarded first-come, first-served.
paragraphs.es: MO HealthNet, la agencia de Medicaid de Missouri, administra tres Programas de Ahorros de Medicare que tambien funcionan como puerta automatica hacia la Ayuda Adicional. QMB cubre a residentes de Missouri con ingresos al 100% o menos del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, $1,330 al mes para un individuo en 2026, y paga las primas de las Partes A y B mas los costos compartidos. SLMB cubre ingresos entre 100% y 120% del FPL, hasta $1,596 al mes, y paga solo la prima de la Parte B. QI cubre ingresos entre 120% y 135% del FPL, hasta $1,796 al mes, y funciona con fondos anuales limitados.

paragraphs.en: Missouri's Medicare Savings Program resource limit is lower than the Extra Help resource test: $9,950 for a single applicant and $14,910 for a married couple in 2026. A Missouri resident who qualifies for QMB, SLMB, or QI is deemed eligible for Extra Help automatically, because Medicare Savings Program enrollment, like MO HealthNet Medicaid or Supplemental Security Income, triggers automatic full Extra Help benefits regardless of a separate SSA application.
paragraphs.es: El limite de recursos del Programa de Ahorros de Medicare de Missouri es menor que la prueba de recursos de la Ayuda Adicional: $9,950 para un solicitante soltero y $14,910 para una pareja casada en 2026. Un residente de Missouri que califica para QMB, SLMB o QI es elegible automaticamente para la Ayuda Adicional, sin necesidad de una solicitud separada ante el Seguro Social.

heading.en: Missouri Medicaid Expansion and the MAGI Difference
heading.es: Expansion de Medicaid en Missouri y la Diferencia del MAGI

paragraphs.en: Missouri expanded Medicaid in 2021 after voters approved Amendment 2 in August 2020, extending MO HealthNet to adults age 19 to 64 with income up to 138% FPL (138% of the Federal Poverty Level), $22,025 for an individual and $45,540 for a family of four in 2026. Because Missouri expanded, the state avoids the ACA coverage gap that still affects the 10 non-expansion states (Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Kansas, Mississippi, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Wisconsin, and Wyoming). Extra Help eligibility works differently from MO HealthNet expansion eligibility: Extra Help uses a higher 150% FPL threshold and counts gross income directly by family size, while MO HealthNet expansion uses MAGI (Modified Adjusted Gross Income) and household composition, so a Missourian's Extra Help status and MO HealthNet status can differ even at similar income levels.
paragraphs.es: Missouri expandio Medicaid en 2021 despues de que los votantes aprobaran la Enmienda 2 en agosto de 2020, extendiendo MO HealthNet a adultos de 19 a 64 anos con ingresos de hasta 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, $22,025 para un individuo y $45,540 para una familia de cuatro en 2026. Debido a que Missouri expandio, el estado evita la brecha de cobertura del ACA que aun afecta a los 10 estados sin expansion. La elegibilidad de la Ayuda Adicional funciona diferente de la elegibilidad de expansion de MO HealthNet: la Ayuda Adicional usa un umbral mas alto del 150% del FPL y cuenta el ingreso bruto directamente, mientras que la expansion de MO HealthNet usa el MAGI y la composicion del hogar.

heading.en: How Missouri Residents Apply for Extra Help
heading.es: Como Solicitan los Residentes de Missouri la Ayuda Adicional

paragraphs.en: Missouri residents who are not already deemed eligible through MO HealthNet, SSI, or a Medicare Savings Program can apply for Extra Help through two channels: directly with Social Security, or through MO HealthNet's Family Support Division, which can screen for Medicaid, Medicare Savings Programs, and Extra Help together during the same application.
paragraphs.es: Los residentes de Missouri que aun no son elegibles automaticamente a traves de MO HealthNet, SSI o un Programa de Ahorros de Medicare pueden solicitar la Ayuda Adicional a traves de dos canales: directamente con el Seguro Social, o a traves de la Division de Apoyo Familiar de MO HealthNet.

heading.en: Common Reasons Extra Help Applications Get Denied (and How to Appeal) in Missouri
heading.es: Razones Comunes de Negacion (y Como Apelar) en Missouri

paragraphs.en: Missouri applicants who apply directly through Social Security or the Family Support Division are denied for a handful of predictable reasons, most of which can be corrected and resubmitted. Household income or countable resources over the limit are the two most common causes, followed by missing documentation of income or household composition.
paragraphs.es: Los solicitantes de Missouri que aplican directamente a traves del Seguro Social o la Division de Apoyo Familiar son rechazados por razones predecibles, la mayoria corregibles y reenviables. Ingresos del hogar o recursos contables por encima del limite son las dos causas mas comunes.

paragraphs.en: A Missouri applicant denied by Social Security has 60 days to request reconsideration in writing, either by mail or at a local Social Security field office. If the denial came through MO HealthNet because the application was filed with the Family Support Division, the applicant can request a Missouri Medicaid fair hearing within 90 days of the notice, and free help is available from a local Area Agency on Aging benefits counselor or Missouri SHIP.
paragraphs.es: Un solicitante de Missouri a quien se le niega la Ayuda Adicional por el Seguro Social tiene 60 dias para solicitar una reconsideracion por escrito. Si la negacion vino a traves de MO HealthNet, el solicitante puede pedir una audiencia justa de Medicaid de Missouri dentro de 90 dias del aviso, y hay ayuda gratuita disponible de Missouri SHIP.

heading.en: MO HealthNet Context: Missouri's Medicaid Agency
heading.es: Contexto de MO HealthNet: la Agencia de Medicaid de Missouri

paragraphs.en: MO HealthNet is Missouri's Medicaid program, administered by the Department of Social Services' Family Support Division and MO HealthNet Division, covering low-income families, pregnant women, children, seniors, and people with disabilities, plus adults under the 2021 expansion group. For Medicare beneficiaries specifically, MO HealthNet also runs Missouri's Medicare Savings Programs, which pay Part B premiums and, for QMB enrollees, cost-sharing, and which double as an automatic gateway into Extra Help.
paragraphs.es: MO HealthNet es el programa de Medicaid de Missouri, administrado por la Division de Apoyo Familiar y la Division de MO HealthNet del Departamento de Servicios Sociales, cubriendo a familias de bajos ingresos, mujeres embarazadas, ninos, personas mayores y personas con discapacidades, ademas de adultos bajo el grupo de expansion de 2021. Para los beneficiarios de Medicare, MO HealthNet tambien administra los Programas de Ahorros de Medicare del estado.

numberedSteps.es: Verifique si ya es elegible automaticamente: si tiene MO HealthNet completo, SSI, o un Programa de Ahorros de Medicare de MO HealthNet, ya tiene la Ayuda Adicional y puede omitir la solicitud.

numberedSteps.es: Solicite en linea en mydss.mo.gov/healthcare/apply, el portal de la Division de Apoyo Familiar de Missouri que evalua MO HealthNet, Programas de Ahorros de Medicare y la Ayuda Adicional juntos, o solicite directamente en ssa.gov o por telefono al 1-800-772-1213.

numberedSteps.en: Watch for a decision letter. If approved, coverage begins the month after approval or January 1, whichever is later.

en.question: What is the Extra Help income limit for a family of 4 in Missouri in 2026?
en.answer: In 2026, a Missouri household of 4 qualifies for Extra Help with income below $49,500 a year ($4,125 a month). This is the same nationwide limit used in every state except Alaska and Hawaii, since Extra Help thresholds are set federally by Social Security rather than by MO HealthNet.

en.question: What counts as income for Extra Help in Missouri?
en.answer: Extra Help counts gross income before taxes, including Social Security benefits, wages, pensions, and rental income, with a few exclusions. This differs from MAGI (Modified Adjusted Gross Income), the calculation MO HealthNet's expansion program and ACA marketplace subsidies use, so a Missourian's Extra Help eligibility and MO HealthNet eligibility can differ even at similar income levels.

en.question: What documents do Missouri applicants need for Extra Help?
en.answer: Missouri applicants need a Social Security number or Medicare card, recent tax returns or W-2s, bank and investment statements, proof of any other income, proof of Missouri residency, and household composition documentation. Applying through the Family Support Division portal can pull some records automatically, but income and asset statements are still required.

en.question: What happens if my Extra Help application is denied in Missouri?
en.answer: A Missouri applicant denied by Social Security has 60 days to request reconsideration in writing. If denied through MO HealthNet after applying via the Family Support Division, the applicant can request a Missouri Medicaid fair hearing within 90 days. Free help is available from a Missouri SHIP counselor or a local Area Agency on Aging.

en.question: Can I work and still get Extra Help in Missouri?
en.answer: Yes, working does not disqualify a Missouri resident from Extra Help as long as total gross household income stays below the 2026 limit for the household size, $23,940 for one person or $32,460 for a couple. Wages are counted as income the same as Social Security or pension income.

en.question: Is Missouri a Medicaid expansion state, and does that matter for Extra Help?
en.answer: Yes. Missouri expanded Medicaid in 2021 after voters approved Amendment 2, covering adults up to 138% of the Federal Poverty Level ($22,025 for an individual in 2026). Because Missouri expanded, there is no ACA coverage gap, and many MO HealthNet-eligible adults who later enroll in Medicare are deemed automatically eligible for Extra Help.

en.question: How long does the Extra Help application take for Missouri residents?
en.answer: Social Security typically decides an Extra Help application within 30 to 45 days of receiving all required documents. Applications submitted through the Family Support Division that also screen for MO HealthNet Medicaid can take a similar timeframe, since MO HealthNet coordinates its determination with the federal Extra Help decision.

en.question: What is the difference between MO HealthNet and Medicare Extra Help?
en.answer: MO HealthNet is Missouri's state Medicaid agency, covering low-income residents of all ages for medical, dental, and long-term care services. Medicare Extra Help is a separate federal program that only reduces Medicare Part D prescription drug costs. Missourians with full MO HealthNet coverage or a MO HealthNet Medicare Savings Program get Extra Help automatically as a bonus benefit.

es.question: Cual es el limite de ingresos de la Ayuda Adicional para una familia de 4 en Missouri en 2026?
es.answer: En 2026, un hogar de Missouri de 4 personas califica para la Ayuda Adicional con ingresos menores a $49,500 al ano ($4,125 al mes). Este es el mismo limite nacional usado en todos los estados excepto Alaska y Hawaii, ya que los umbrales los fija el Seguro Social, no MO HealthNet.

es.question: Que cuenta como ingreso para la Ayuda Adicional en Missouri?
es.answer: La Ayuda Adicional cuenta el ingreso bruto antes de impuestos, incluidos los beneficios del Seguro Social, salarios, pensiones e ingresos por alquiler, con algunas exclusiones. Esto difiere del MAGI, el calculo que usa el programa de expansion de MO HealthNet y los subsidios del mercado del ACA.

es.question: Que documentos necesitan los solicitantes de Missouri para la Ayuda Adicional?
es.answer: Los solicitantes de Missouri necesitan un numero de Seguro Social o tarjeta de Medicare, declaraciones de impuestos recientes o W-2, estados de cuenta bancarios y de inversion, prueba de otros ingresos, prueba de residencia en Missouri y documentacion de composicion del hogar.

es.question: Que pasa si se niega mi solicitud de Ayuda Adicional en Missouri?
es.answer: Un solicitante de Missouri a quien se le niega por el Seguro Social tiene 60 dias para solicitar una reconsideracion por escrito. Si la negacion vino de MO HealthNet despues de solicitar por la Division de Apoyo Familiar, puede pedir una audiencia justa dentro de 90 dias.

es.question: Puedo trabajar y aun recibir la Ayuda Adicional en Missouri?
es.answer: Si, trabajar no descalifica a un residente de Missouri de la Ayuda Adicional siempre que el ingreso bruto total del hogar se mantenga por debajo del limite de 2026 para el tamano del hogar, $23,940 para una persona o $32,460 para una pareja.

es.question: Es Missouri un estado de expansion de Medicaid, y eso importa para la Ayuda Adicional?
es.answer: Si. Missouri expandio Medicaid en 2021 despues de que los votantes aprobaran la Enmienda 2, cubriendo a adultos hasta el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($22,025 para un individuo en 2026). Debido a que Missouri expandio, no hay brecha de cobertura del ACA.

es.question: Cuanto tiempo toma la solicitud de Ayuda Adicional para los residentes de Missouri?
es.answer: El Seguro Social generalmente decide una solicitud de Ayuda Adicional dentro de 30 a 45 dias de recibir todos los documentos requeridos. Las solicitudes enviadas por la Division de Apoyo Familiar que tambien evaluan MO HealthNet pueden tomar un tiempo similar.

es.question: Cual es la diferencia entre MO HealthNet y la Ayuda Adicional de Medicare?
es.answer: MO HealthNet es la agencia estatal de Medicaid de Missouri, que cubre a residentes de bajos ingresos de todas las edades para servicios medicos, dentales y de cuidado a largo plazo. La Ayuda Adicional de Medicare es un programa federal separado que solo reduce los costos de medicamentos de la Parte D.
